name: aegis-crypto
description: Autonomous on-chain token scanner: security auditing, deployer reputation, smart money tracking, Obsidian notes and Telegram alerts.
_dependencyNote: The scanner itself stays dependency-free and runs on Node built-ins alone.
`telegram` (GramJS) is required ONLY by telegram_listener.mjs, because
MTProto is a custom binary protocol with its own crypto — it cannot be
spoken with fetch. Every other entry point still works with node_modules
absent, and the listener loads it lazily so a missing install produces an
GramJS is archived upstream. `teleproto` is a largely API-compatible
maintained fork; loadGramJs() in telegram_listener.mjs is the only place
the import would need to change.
